verdict.rationale: The only evidence resembling bulk operations is backfilling months of historical data into Sift (sift-docs-4), which implies some batch ingestion capability, but there is no documentation of a dedicated batch API, bulk scoring/decision endpoint, or any mechanism for programmatically acting on many items simultaneously. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API documentation, evidence of bulk decision or workflow actions, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk operation support.
